chapter: First big band, his father, arriving in Kansas City
title: His father's heart trouble and death at 47
summary: His father got short of breath driving, had heart trouble and died at 47, which was before McShann headed to Omaha.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: We should come back to this, though. When you have you own band. We should talk a bit about that business aspect of it.
Well, let me ask Jay then, just to finish it off. Well, then, your dad fell sick, did he? Did you know he was sick?
Yes, I came to visit him once and he told me, he says, "You know what? I get to driving this truck and I just run out of breath. I run out of wind. I don't

know. I've been going to the doctor, and I don't know what the trouble is." I said, "Well, wait a minute. Hold it there. Pull on over there and stop and let me drive." He said, "No, I'm all right now. But at certain times, it hits. And I think it's heart trouble," and that's what it was. It was heart trouble.
How old was he when he died?
Lord, he wasn't very old, was he?
Yes, he died at 47. And he explained it and told me and I told him, I says, "I think it would be a good idea to look into that and see what it is, you know, what the trouble is."
Well, do you think it was because he'd been working too hard?
That was it. He worked hard, yes. That's what I think, you see, because he was a hard worker and he --
Well, when you were going to Omaha, was that after he died?
